audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] agree on every one of the seven rows (Swain, Skill, Akali, Akali, Swain, Akali, Akali), and the mirror audit made no chart claim. Packet levelChart differs only at row 6 ('Skill'), which is the stale generated chart, not a layer disagreement — left alone rather than flipping a row on no evidence.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked cooldown was named but never numbered — Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s, the longest cooldown in her kit and the whole basis of the 'engage when it is down' advice.
audit.why: Advice keyed to a real number is actionable; 'when it is down' is not.
audit.corrected: Twilight Shroud's 20s rank-1 cooldown and your E's 12s written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t; Shuriken Flip's 13s at rank 3 named in whys[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly said Twilight Shroud dodges your W and that she is simply untargetable to you. Swain's W (Vision of Empire) is flagged revealsStealth — champions hit are revealed — so it is exactly the tool that answers the smoke. Also, Nevermove roots on the wave's RETURN trip, not the outgoing cast, which is why she can flip out of it.
audit.why: Riot's own text: 'Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment' (W) and 'It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits' (E). The mirror audit recorded both from Akali's side.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0], dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and whys[2] now state that W reveals her inside the shroud and that E roots on the return trip.
sources: ownerKit Swain W/E text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Assassin's Mark's auto-attack reset was never mentioned, and dontsFull[1].d ('Stand still for her combo') carried filler text about wasting a cooldown.
audit.why: Her burst opens on the empowered auto, so the wind-up is the tell, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now names Assassin's Mark as the reset tell.
